title: Sex & Fury
writer: Tarô Bonten, Masahiro Kakefuda, Norifumi Suzuki
actors: Reiko Ike, Akemi Negishi, Ryôko Ema
plot: During the Meiji era, a gambler named Ochô takes revenge on the three gangsters who killed her father, shelters a wanted anarchist, and crosses paths with a British femme fatale.
